notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to announce that I'm working on an update that will include the following features:


 Make combat more idle by allowing players to minimize the combat window.
 Allow players to directly engage in combat with monsters that they have already defeated.


I hope you're as excited about these new features as I am! I'll keep you updated on the progress of the update.

Best regards,
Romulo Lima
